title: Apple Fitness doesn’t sync with my workout apps
body:
The goal of this app is nice. But please fix some features: 
1) Sync the app with workout apps well. My workout app (Huawei Watch Fit 4) stated I burned 400+ kcal, but the Apple Fitness only record 200ish kcal. If you measure with steps and distance as indicator, both apps record nearly the same numbers. But on the calories, why is the gap so high? This happened so many times. 
2) Add report menu, so I don’t have to complain it here.
